title: Bounce Dodge
description: Drag to move your bar, dodge the bouncing blocks and survive as long as you can. Score is survival time.

license.attributionText: Bounce Dodge by the Moydan examples contributors, MIT licensed.

assets.source: original artwork drawn for this example
assets.attribution: "Bounce Dodge" shield mark, drawn from scratch for the Moydan examples, MIT licensed.

parameters.label: Block speed
parameters.description: Multiplier on how fast the blocks fall.

parameters.label: Lives
parameters.description: Hits you can take before the run ends.

parameters.label: Accent colour
parameters.description: Colour of the bar, the blocks and the life pips.

parameters.label: Screen shake
parameters.description: Shake the view for a moment when you are hit.

parameters.label: Sound
parameters.description: Play the Web Audio blips. The host can always mute the game.
